valor: Busco y hablo con los muertos. Le escribo a Soraya Cataño, asesinada en Medellín en 1991. Treinta años después la encuentro en una imagen; el archivo revela su risa, sus gestos, y decido invocarla. Yo también crecí en este valle. Esta película no es sobre la muerte: es una carta fílmica a quien resiste desde la ausencia. Un fuego que no se apaga.
motivo: una sola sinopsis por obra: la sugerida de la hoja (midbo-2026)

valor: I seek out and speak with the dead. I write to Soraya Cataño, murdered in Medellín in 1991. Thirty years later I find her in an image; the archive reveals her laughter, her gestures, and I decide to invoke her. I too grew up in this valley. This film is not about death: it is a filmic letter to one who resists from absence. A fire that never dies.

antes.cortoscali-2026: I seek out and speak with the dead. I write to a woman no longer here: Soraya Cataño, murdered in Medellín in 1991. Thirty years later, I find her in an image. Her voice rises as a parade climbs the hillside. The archive reveals her laughter, her gesture, and I choose to call her forth.I too was raised in this valley.  I too believed. I believe. This film is not about death. It is a dialogue between the one who narrates and the one who resists through absence. It is a fire that does not fade.
